steps.imagePrompt: Flat vector illustration, 16:9, for an online C++ course. Inside the high-tech technical maintenance bay of Mars base IRIS. A faceted geometric scout drone Sigma in dark slate #151A22 and warm grey #B7B0A4 hovers docked at an illuminated diagnostic console terminal. The console terminal has a glowing rectangular monitor showing abstract digital diagnostic readouts composed purely of flat rectangular binary status blocks, horizontal progress/level bars, and segmented matrix grids in aged brass #B99A61. Standing on the floor near the console, observing the diagnostic readout, is the course mascot: refer directly to mascot-reference.png. The mascot consists strictly of two freestanding cream-colored square brackets facing each other [ ] with two round cream circular eyes between them, exactly as in the reference image. The mascot has NO legs, NO feet, NO body, NO black bounding box, NO arms. Background shows minimal geometric maintenance bay architecture (#151A22, #090B0F) and an observation window revealing flat Martian terrain in desaturated warm grey (#B7B0A4), strictly no red. Style: minimalist geometric flat vector, solid color fills, zero outlines, no gradients, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, technical and calm. Color palette strictly: #090B0F, #151A22, #B7B0A4, #D8D0C2, with aged brass #B99A61 only on the console display glow.
